7655550179.label: Dr. Victor Lin
7655550179.transcript:
This is Dr. Victor Lin.

Yes, I attended Nathaniel's Thanksgiving dinner. We had an argument about the research investigation. It was a private matter between two old friends, and I would rather not discuss the details.

I left the gathering after our disagreement. Nathaniel was upset, and I thought it would be better to give him some space.

As for the time of his death, I was speaking with Dean Margaret Wallace on the telephone from approximately 10:15 until 10:40 that night.

You don't have to take my word for it.

Call Dean Wallace's office at 765-555-0112. I'm sure she can confirm our conversation.

I had known Nathaniel for over twenty years. Whatever our disagreements, I never wanted things to end this way.

7655550112.label: Dean Margaret Wallace
7655550112.transcript:
This is Dr. Margaret Wallace, Dean of the College of Science at West La La University.

I understand that you are verifying Dr. Victor Lin's account of Thanksgiving evening.

Yes, I can confirm that Dr. Lin and I spoke by telephone on November 27, 2008.

Our conversation began at approximately 10:15 PM and ended at 10:40 PM.

We discussed the pending research integrity review involving Professor Nathaniel Whitmore.

Dr. Lin sounded distressed. He expressed serious concerns about the possible consequences of the investigation.

However, I cannot confirm Dr. Lin's movements before our telephone conversation or establish his physical location during the call.

I hope this clarifies the matter.

7655550134.label: Daniel Mercer
7655550134.transcript:
Hello, this is Daniel Mercer.

Yes, I was at Professor Whitmore's Thanksgiving dinner.

We argued earlier that evening, but it was about the research. I had been asking him for the original experimental records, and he kept refusing to show them to me.

I left with Sophie at around 10:35 PM. We took the university shuttle back to campus.

I was heading to the Chemistry Building. I had laboratory work and research files to check.

You can check the bus tickets. Sophie and I were on the same shuttle.

I didn't know Professor Whitmore was dead when we left. The last I knew, he had gone outside to the balcony.

Look, I know how this sounds, but I just wanted the truth about the research. That's all.

7655550138.label: Sophie Bennett
7655550138.transcript:
Hello? This is Sophie Bennett.
Yes, I attended Professor Whitmore's Thanksgiving dinner.
I left around 9:35 because I needed to go to the university library. I had some research to finish, and things were getting uncomfortable at the dinner.
Later that evening, I met Daniel, and we took the 10:35 shuttle back to campus together.
I realized afterward that I'd forgotten my ukulele bag. I tried calling Daniel around 11:08, but he didn't answer.
So I took another shuttle back to Lark.
When I returned to the townhouse around 11:32, I went looking for my ukulele.
That's when I saw Professor Whitmore on the balcony.
He was slumped in his chair, with a knife sticking out of his chest. I thought he might still be alive, but he wasn't responding.
I was terrified. I called the police at 11:42.
I don't know what happened to him. I really don't.

7655550153.label: Claire Whitmore
7655550153.transcript:
This is Claire Whitmore.

Yes, Nathaniel and I were having problems. We were getting divorced.

And yes, I needed money. But it wasn't for me. Our son Owen has been receiving treatment at St. Agnes Children's Hospital, and the bills have become unbearable.

I tried to speak with Nathaniel during Thanksgiving dinner, but he wouldn't listen.

I was exhausted. I couldn't stay there anymore.

I had already asked Martha, our neighbor, whether I could come over.

I eventually went to her apartment.

I don't know what else you want me to say.

Please leave Owen out of this.

7655550186.label: Martha, Apartment 16
7655550186.transcript:
Hello, this is Martha from Apartment 16.

Claire is my neighbor. I've known her for a while.

She sent me a message around 10:09 PM on Thanksgiving night, asking whether she could come over.

I told her of course, and said I'd put the kettle on.

But she didn't arrive immediately.

I remember it was almost ten fifty when she finally knocked on my door.

She looked absolutely terrible. She was pale, upset, and shaking.

I thought she'd been arguing with Nathaniel again, so I didn't push her for an explanation.

She sat down, and I made her some tea.

That's really all I remember.

7655550193.label: Attorney Margaret Foster
7655550193.transcript:
This is Margaret Foster of Foster & Associates.

I represent Mrs. Claire Whitmore in her pending marital dissolution proceedings.

On November 24, 2008, our office prepared a proposed financial settlement totaling one hundred fifty thousand dollars.

The proposal included an initial payment of eighty-four thousand five hundred sixty dollars and thirty cents, requested by Friday, November 28, at five o'clock in the afternoon.

Professor Whitmore had not agreed to the proposed settlement as of Thanksgiving evening.

Mrs. Whitmore contacted my office several times regarding the matter.

I advised her that the settlement remained unsigned and that any further action would have to follow the appropriate legal process.

I cannot comment further on confidential communications with my client.

7655550164.label: WLLU Chemistry Laboratory
7655550164.transcript:
You have reached the Chemistry Department Laboratory Office at West La La University.

Regarding Daniel Mercer's research activity on November 27, 2008, our laboratory records show that his university account was used to access research resources late that evening.

A remote connection was recorded at approximately 10:46 PM.

This was a Remote VPN session, not a physical laboratory door-entry event.

The record therefore does not establish whether Mr. Mercer was physically inside the Chemistry Building at that time.

The laboratory office also received a brief telephone call associated with Mr. Mercer's number at approximately 10:47 PM.

For detailed research records, please contact the Department of Chemistry.

7655550146.label: St. Agnes Children’s Hospital Billing
7655550146.transcript:
Thank you for calling St. Agnes Children's Hospital Patient Accounts.

For the purposes of the authorized case inquiry, we can confirm that the November 20, 2008 account statement for Owen Whitmore lists an outstanding balance of eighty-four thousand five hundred sixty dollars and thirty cents.

The earlier October 20 statement listed a balance of fifty-five thousand two hundred eighty dollars and thirty cents.

Further account information requires appropriate authorization.

For questions concerning billing arrangements, please contact the Patient Accounts Department during regular business hours.

7655550287.label: Professor Nathaniel Whitmore — archived greeting
7655550287.transcript:
You have reached the office of Professor Nathaniel Whitmore, Department of Chemistry, West La La University.

I am currently unavailable.

For research-related matters, please leave your name, contact number, and a brief message.

Students requiring access to original experimental data should arrange an appointment through the department office.

Thank you.

7655550182.label: Dr. Evelyn Shaw
7655550182.transcript:
This is Dr. Evelyn Shaw.

I worked with Professor Whitmore on several analytical chemistry research projects in previous years.

I was not present at his Thanksgiving gathering on November 27.

I understand questions have been raised about the reproducibility of measurements in some of our publications.

The original data should be examined carefully before any conclusions are reached.

I cannot speak to what happened at the townhouse that evening.

I hope the investigation distinguishes the scientific concerns from the circumstances of Nathaniel's death.
